purpose: One compact labelled trigger that opens a related detail region.
useWhen: A detail region is owned by another component and several surfaces need the same trigger treatment.

avoidWhen.reason: The trigger and content are a self-contained block; use Collapsible.

rationale: Nearest alternative: Collapsible. DisclosureTrigger owns only the accessible compact trigger so hosts can preserve their existing detail layout and state.
